name: cica-platform
description: CICA shared runtime libraries (@cica/*): logger, express-baseline, nunjucks-govuk. npm-workspaces monorepo; each package is published and imported independently.

scripts.secrets:scan:local: command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm run secrets:scan || echo 'gitleaks not installed — skipping local secret scan (CI will run it)'
scripts.prepush: npm test && npm run lint:check && npm run audit:ci && npm run secrets:scan:local
